title: EMOM Pulse
description: 10-minute EMOM with squat jumps, diamond push-ups and toe touches to keep the pulse up

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral movements, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a maximum jump, cushion the landing

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands close together under the chest, elbows along the body

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch the feet with your hands

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, pivot the body

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
